result.requirement: Prove universal helper lemmas for the reachable-state proof: a topic's candidate peers are unique when the peerTopics keys are unique; lookup in a fanout map returns unique peers when every stored entry has unique peers; applySubscription preserves uniqueness of peerTopics keys. Keep the original router operations and all three WellFormed conditions. This helper stage does not establish the full gossip_reachability trace requirement.
